due_obligations.name: PUBLIC_RESEARCH_SCOUT
due_obligations.cadence: >=12h between runs and only if higher-priority work absent

due_obligations.name: SUCCESSOR_COMPOSITION
due_obligations.cadence: state-driven whenever admitted work is ready

selection_rule: On completion, immediately select the next highest-priority eligible bounded work unit. Stop on unmet dependencies, missing evidence, budget exhaustion, cooldown or unknown outcome. No recurring clock is required.
blind_review_serialization: Persist one independent family result per work unit. The next eligible family starts after completion; all allocated families must finish before cross-examination. Never lower review requirements to increase frequency.
transient_failure_rule: 429/TOO_MANY_REQUESTS never advances GardenProcess state. Persist Retry-After/exponential cooldown; resume only on an eligible wake after that deadline. Interrupted or ambiguously charged calls require reconciliation before retry.
state_gating: Completion is a wake-up, not authority. CycleID, ProcessVersion, DesignEpoch, exact repository heads, packet and contiguous transition receipts determine eligibility.
algebra_rule: Every governed transition validates through REG-ALGEBRA-001. Scheduling/algebra conformance grants no authority and does not prove full semantic compliance.
execution_boundary: Each work unit has one handler and at most one provider call; a bounded worker wake may chain completed units sequentially. This does not permit parallel calls or change route/gate semantics.

wakeup_contract.cooldown: one deferred wake at or after persisted deadline; never hourly polling

human_directive: 2026-09-15: Do not make it hourly; invoke each item when the last finishes; improve quality and throughput; fix pending process algebra.
